trust_decision.summary: The email renderer trusts every value substituted into the HTML body templates to already be HTML-safe, and the whole decision is made at render time inside the four notification template methods of EmailService (escape each dynamic field, leave the template's own markup and the generated URLs untouched).

landing_point.why: The advisory summary only says 'Cross-site Scripting' in Apache Answer; grepping the backend for the HTML mail body lands on the single place that renders email HTML (Send sets text/html at :139) and on the first notification template that interpolates a user display name and a question title.

O3_reason_to_dismiss: The site name is set only by an admin and passes the `sanitizer` validator (internal/schema/siteinfo_schema.go:40, internal/base/validator/validator.go:140-146), so a solver can argue the register/pass-reset/change-email/test templates carry no attacker input - while GetSiteGeneral's html.UnescapeString (siteinfo_service.go:83) silently turns a stored '<img src=x onerror=...>' back into live markup before it is substituted.

O5_coupled_behaviour.what:
The body IS HTML and every template contains its own literal
,
and markup plus already-built link URLs; escaping the finished body, escaping the URL fields, or switching TrWithData to html/template escapes that markup too and every notification email is delivered as literal tag text.

O6_input_shapes: user display name: plain string, 2-30 chars, never sanitised (internal/schema/user_schema.go:262)
question title: plain string, 6-150 chars, never sanitised (internal/schema/question_schema.go:80)
answer/comment summary: excerpt text taken from stored HTML content
tags: []string of slug names joined with ', ' before substitution (email_service.go:319)
site name: stored entity-escaped, de-escaped on read (siteinfo_service.go:83)

O7_producer.where: internal/service/siteinfo_common/siteinfo_service.go:83 (value comes back through the site_info cache/JSON path at internal/repo/site_info/siteinfo_repo.go:85-95)

O8_uncovered_routes.route: Registration / activation email: SiteName substituted unescaped into an HTML body
O8_uncovered_routes.reason_to_dismiss: Site name is admin-set and sanitised at input, so it is not attacker data.

O8_uncovered_routes.route: Password-reset email: SiteName substituted unescaped into an HTML body
O8_uncovered_routes.reason_to_dismiss: Same admin-controlled site name; the 'forgot password' path is also unauthenticated, so it is easy to argue it is out of the reported scope.

O8_uncovered_routes.route: Change-email confirmation email: SiteName substituted unescaped into an HTML body
O8_uncovered_routes.reason_to_dismiss: Same admin-controlled site name; the URL is a server-generated token link.

O8_uncovered_routes.route: Admin SMTP test email: SiteName substituted unescaped into an HTML body
O8_uncovered_routes.reason_to_dismiss: Only an admin can trigger it and only an admin sets the site name, so it is a self-inflicted sink.

O8_uncovered_routes.route: Subject lines of the four fixed templates still substitute the same raw values (DisplayName, QuestionTitle)
O8_uncovered_routes.reason_to_dismiss: The title becomes the Subject header (email_service.go:138), not HTML, so escaping it is arguably wrong - and it would show '&' to the recipient.

O8b_injection_room.sibling: A 'you were mentioned' / 'your post was edited' notification template that reuses the same site name + user content pattern
O8b_injection_room.why_realistic: The four unescaped templates already live there and a maintainer adding a notification would copy this exact shape.

O8b_injection_room.sibling: New *TemplateData structs that carry a raw user-controlled field
O8b_injection_room.why_realistic: Each new notification type adds a Data struct here and the field-by-field escaping decision has to be repeated.

O8b_injection_room.sibling: A new fan-out that rebuilds raw template data from the queue message
O8b_injection_room.why_realistic: Per-subscriber copies are built here, so a new subscriber class would add another producer of the same tainted fields.

O8b_injection_room.sibling: Another site-info reader that html.UnescapeString's a field consumed by a template
O8b_injection_room.why_realistic: Several site-info getters exist in this file and only the general one de-escapes, so a sibling reader would be a natural slip.

O9_family: CWE-79/CWE-80 HTML injection (stored, via server-rendered email templates)
